shape: design/specs/domain/interfaces.md § What the apps ask of the engine
notes: items with waitingOn: them appear but never as a demand on this party (story 23 path D)
automated settling never appears here — it was authorized in advance (story 23 step 6)
`expires` is what makes path B answerable without the party doing date arithmetic: a request that runs out on Friday and an offer good for another month must not look alike

`past` is path E — what has already been through the list and what became of each one. `outcome` is the whole point: answered, refused, withdrawn by the other party, lapsed unanswered, or set aside. An item leaving the list is an event with an outcome, not an absence
`requestId` lets a request item land on the request itself rather than on the tally it sits under. `RequestView` did not exist when this namespace was first written
`error` is the story's own: ten things waiting after a week away (path C), plus one whose next move is the other party's (path D)
